description: Research argues that particular aspects of religion facilitate both institutional and interpersonal manipulation in ways that differ from secular settings - the authority is not merely positional.
energy_note: Not his authority. His access to something larger.

description: Offenders may occupy several social roles simultaneously - the child's coach and a fellow congregant - which multiplies access and multiplies the cost of disclosure.
energy_note: He is three people in her life and all of them matter.

aspect: Leaving costs the entire social world
description: Community, marriage prospects, family standing, childcare and employment are frequently all inside the congregation.
energy_note: The exit costs everyone she knows.

description: 'Have you prayed about your part in this?' She came to report what her husband does. The conversation is now about her submission, her patience and what she might be withholding. She does not come back.
energy_note: Reported him, and left having been assessed herself.
